MMLA offers home health, infusion, and research services. We are a staff of Skilled Nursing Clinicians that base our success on our patients' long-term good health.

We believe in personalized care based on your health concerns.

To schedule an appointment,
please call: (213) 545- MMLA (6652)

We are committed to advancing the practice of home infusion nursing through continuous education, innovation, and adherence to the highest standards of safety and care. Our goal is to empower patients to live more independently and joyfully, minimizing the disruption to their lives and fostering a positive healing environment. The heart of our mission lies in our belief that everyone deserves access to quality healthcare services that respect their dignity, preferences, and unique needs.

We envision a future where every individual requiring infusion therapy can access top-tier, personalized nursing care in the sanctuary of their own home, surrounded by the comfort and support of their loved ones. Our aim is to extend our reach, ensuring that no patient is left behind due to geographical, physical, or socioeconomic barriers.
